author: codex

human_neuron67_K56213.provenance: 67 cortical WT RATEseq loss rates;13 K562 whole-cell fallback;75 early-pulse normalized synthesis shapes with an assumed common count-to-uM factor;5 synthesis rates inferred at0.001uM. Initial totals alpha/k are inferred. Uniform compartment loss. Not humanMN calibrated.

hybrid_equal_RNA_reference.provenance: Sensitivity profile: same67cortical+13K562 effective loss rates, but uniform assumed0.001uM totals and alpha=k*M. No observed relative synthesis input in this alternative.

K562_whole_cell.provenance: Non-neuronal alternative: arithmetic mean of2primary K562whole-cell MAP rates for80genes; uniform assumed0.001uM and inferredalpha=k*M. Some reported posterior means violate bounds implied by positive support and central95CrI; raw values retained. No invented division-rate subtraction; not a neuron calibration.

K562_point_estimate_policy: Arithmetic mean of2replicate MAP rates; neither mean ofhalf-lives nor jointposterior estimate. Raw posterior means and credible intervals retained, including source inconsistencies.
scaling_definition: Set median(alpha_rel/k) of paired67QC corticalgenes to inherited0.001uM; not absolute measurement. SS counts not used.
